question: Which country is developing the 'Gelephu Mindfulness City' to promote economic growth, wellness, and sustainability?
solution:
The correct answer is option 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Gelephu Mindfulness City** is an ambitious urban development project initiated by the Kingdom of Bhutan.
 
• The project is focused on promoting **economic growth, sustainability, and holistic wellness** through mindfulness-centric urban planning.
 
• The city aims to integrate **green infrastructure**, renewable energy, and eco-friendly practices into its design.
 
• Located in the **Sarpang District**, Gelephu serves as a strategic location for Bhutan's development goals due to its proximity to India.
 
• The initiative aligns with Bhutan's commitment to **Gross National Happiness (GNH)**, which prioritizes well-being over material wealth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gross National Happiness (GNH)**

 
 
• GNH is Bhutan's unique development philosophy that emphasizes holistic well-being over GDP growth.
 
• It incorporates four pillars: sustainable development, environmental conservation, cultural preservation, and good governance.
 
• GNH is a global model for integrating mindfulness and happiness into governance and policy-making.
 
 
 
• **Green Infrastructure**
 
 
• Green infrastructure refers to urban planning that incorporates natural ecosystems to enhance environmental sustainability.
 
• In Gelephu Mindfulness City, this includes renewable energy systems, eco-friendly buildings, and waste management practices.
 
 
 
• **Sustainability in Urban Development**
 
 
• Sustainable urban development focuses on creating environmentally friendly and socially inclusive cities.
 
• Projects like Gelephu Mindfulness City aim to reduce carbon footprints and optimize resource efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Bhutan-India Relations**
 
 
• Bhutan shares close cultural, economic, and strategic ties with India.
 
• Gelephu’s location near India enhances cross-border trade and connectivity, supporting Bhutan's development objectives.
